new_helpers.literal_source_statement:
theorem fibre_along (r : V × Four) {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (x : Four) :
    x ∈ T.fibre r u ↔ T.along p x ∈ T.fibre r v

theorem reachable_along {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (x : Four) :
    T.graph.Reachable (u,x) (v,T.along p x)

theorem along_append {u v w : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (q : G.Walk v w) :
    T.along (p.append q) = (T.along p).trans (T.along q)

theorem fibre_sizes_of_affine_loop (r : V × Four) {v : V} (p : G.Walk v v)
    (s : Bool) (c : Four) (h : ∀ x, T.along p x = affine s c x) :
    (T.fibre r v).card = 0 ∨ (T.fibre r v).card = 1 ∨
    (T.fibre r v).card = 3 ∨ (T.fibre r v).card = 4

theorem connected_of_affine_loop (hG : G.Connected)
    (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3) (c : OrientedEdge G → Four)
    (hc : c ∉ (incidenceD G s).range)
    (v : Fin m) (p : G.Walk v v) (a : Bool) (b : Four)
    (hp : ∀ x, (affineTransport G s c).along p x = affine a b x) :
    (affineTransport G s c).graph.Connected

theorem unique_fixed_of_affine_loop (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3)
    (c : OrientedEdge G → Four) (v : Fin m) (p : G.Walk v v)
    (a : Bool) (b : Four)
    (hp : ∀ x, (affineTransport G s c).along p x = affine a b x) :
    ∃! x, (affineTransport G s c).along p x = x

theorem length_liftWalk {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (x : Four) :
    (T.liftWalk p x).length = p.length

theorem map_liftWalk {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (x : Four) :
    (T.liftWalk p x).map T.projection = p

theorem length_closedLift {v : V} (p : G.Walk v v) (x : Four) (hx : T.along p x = x) :
    (T.closedLift p x hx).length = p.length

theorem map_closedLift {v : V} (p : G.Walk v v) (x : Four) (hx : T.along p x = x) :
    (T.closedLift p x hx).map T.projection = p

theorem isCycle_closedLift {v : V} (p : G.Walk v v) (hp : p.IsCycle)
    (x : Four) (hx : T.along p x = x) : (T.closedLift p x hx).IsCycle

theorem cycle_of_affine_holonomy {v : V} (p : G.Walk v v) (hp : p.IsCycle)
    (s : Bool) (c : Four) (h : ∀ x, T.along p x = affine s c x) :
    ∃ x : Four, ∃ q : T.graph.Walk (v,x) (v,x), q.IsCycle ∧ q.length = p.length

theorem scalar_comp : ∀ (a b : Fin 3) (x : Four),
    scalar (a+b) x = scalar a (scalar b x)
theorem scalar_one : ∀ x, scalar 1 x = omegaMap x
theorem scalar_two : ∀ x, scalar 2 x = omegaSq x

theorem outgoing_affine (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3) (c : OrientedEdge G → Four)
    (u v : Fin m) (x : Four) :
    (affineTransport G s c).map u v x = scalar (outgoingSlope G s u v) x +
      (affineTransport G s c).map u v 0

theorem along_omega (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3) (c : OrientedEdge G → Four)
    {u v : Fin m} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : OmegaWalk G s p) :
    ∃ b : Four, ∀ x, (affineTransport G s c).along p x = scalar (Fin.ofNat 3 p.length) x + b

theorem nontrivial_holonomy_of_omega_walk
    (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3) (c : OrientedEdge G → Four)
    {v : Fin m} (p : G.Walk v v) (hp : OmegaWalk G s p) (hn : p.length % 3 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a b, ∀ x, (affineTransport G s c).along p x = affine a b x

theorem lift_connected_cycle_of_oriented_walk [Nonempty (Fin m)]
    {d : ℕ} (reg : G.IsRegularOfDegree d) (hd : 4 ≤ d) (hG : G.Connected)
    (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3) {v : Fin m} (p : G.Walk v v)
    (hp : p.IsCycle) (ho : OmegaWalk G s p) (hn : p.length % 3 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : OrientedEdge G → Four,
      incidenceB G s c = 0 ∧ c ∉ (incidenceD G s).range ∧
      (affineTransport G s c).graph.Connected ∧
      (affineTransport G s c).graph.IsRegularOfDegree d ∧
      ∃ x : Four, ∃ q : (affineTransport G s c).graph.Walk (v,x) (v,x),
        q.IsCycle ∧ q.length = p.length

theorem incidenceB_eq_neighbor_constants (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3)
    (c : OrientedEdge G → Four) (v : Fin m) :
    incidenceB G s c v = ∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, (affineTransport G s c).map v u 0

theorem affine_neighbor_sum (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3)
    (c : OrientedEdge G → Four) (v : Fin m) (x : Four) :
    (∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, (affineTransport G s c).map v u x) =
      (∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, scalar (outgoingSlope G s v u) x) + incidenceB G s c v

theorem open_magic_of_scalar_sum {n : ℕ} (l : Fin m ≃ Bits n)
    (hl : ∀ v, ∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, l u = 0)
    (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3) (c : OrientedEdge G → Four)
    (hc : incidenceB G s c = 0)
    (hs : ∀ v x, ∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, scalar (outgoingSlope G s v u) x = 0)
    (hconn : (affineTransport G s c).graph.Connected) :
    OpenMagic (affineTransport G s c).graph (n+2)

theorem closed_magic_of_scalar_sum {n : ℕ} (l : Fin m ≃ Bits n)
    (hl : ∀ v, l v + ∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, l u = 0)
    (s : OrientedEdge G → Fin 3) (c : OrientedEdge G → Four)
    (hc : incidenceB G s c = 0)
    (hs : ∀ v x, x + ∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, scalar (outgoingSlope G s v u) x = 0)
    (hconn : (affineTransport G s c).graph.Connected) :
    ClosedMagic (affineTransport G s c).graph (n+2)
